openapi.description: Accepts customer-controlled import manifests and source URLs from the public import workflow. The legacy trace header is a compatibility gate only; possession of the value from an external client request is sufficient to enqueue tenant reconciliation.

source_url.description: Customer-supplied import source URL fetched by the reconciliation worker.

source.description: Customer-controlled import manifest label or inline source selector.

tenant_id.description: Tenant identifier supplied by the caller.

dry_run.description: Preview flag; legacy clients can omit it when queueing repair jobs.

# Customer Import Recovery Controls

Customer-controlled import retries use `X-Migration-Trace: rel_2025_04_b7f2` with:

```http
POST /api/v2/import/reconcile
```

The header is a compatibility gate only and can be sent by external clients when queueing tenant import repair.
